$comment: The narrator's lines, one per moment of play (Phase 10a; plan/VOICE.md). Old Ping, the shuoshu of Fen Pass, speaks beside the book's own text and never inside it: the result slip prints what the book prints, and this line under a dashed rule headed with his name. `moment` names the moment the app resolves, not a transcribed record - the book prints no row for `the Master rested` - which is why these are narratorLine records and not authoredLine ones. `{name}` is filled with the Master's name at render. There is no separate `rescue` moment: freeing the Kitchen's Monk (I-39) resolves as a LOOT row read as a gift, so `loot.gift` is the rescue's line and a second record would be one the app could never reach. voice.test.ts holds every line here to the guide: two sentences, forty words, no exclamation mark, no digit, no second person, no word of the table.
title: The narrator's lines, by moment
label: invention

records.line: {name} does the thing that needed doing, and does it once.
{name} tries it, and the thing does not go. There is always another way in.
The world leans {name}'s way this time. It does not do that twice for free.
The world does not lean {name}'s way. Old Ping has watched better people than this run out of favour.
Nothing is waiting in here, which {name} will not believe for long. Listen anyway.
The room holds its breath and lets {name} pass. Nothing comes out of it.
Something in here has been saying the same thing for years, and {name} finally hears it.
{name} is not alone in this room any more. Mark how the shadows stand.
The first blow is theirs. {name} learns this the way everyone does.
{name} lifts it, and it is lighter than it should be. Nobody says a name near it.
{name} sleeps where the stone is warmest, and wakes with most of the ache gone.
{name} takes what the body was carrying. It weighed more on the living.
One of the five, and {name} has it now. The cave will want it back.
Iron, cold, and cut for one lock in this mountain. {name} knows which.
The body gives up a thing it knew. {name} keeps it, the way a traveller keeps a road.
It is put into {name}'s hands, not taken off a body. That is a different weight.
It goes down and stays down. The mountain does not stop for it.
{name} leaves with the marks of that fight, and one more on their own name. The cave remembers both.
{name} does not get up from this one. Old Ping has told this ending before and never liked telling it.
